arxiv-2106-11593.description: Abstract Recently, Graph Neural Network (GNN) has achieved remarkable success in various real-world problems on graph data. However in most industries, data exists in the form of isolated islands and the data privacy and security is also an important issue.

arxiv-2204-04477.title: FoundationLayerNorm: Scaling BERT and GPT to 1,000 Layers
arxiv-2204-04477.creator: Dezhou Shen
arxiv-2204-04477.description: Abstract The mainstream BERT/GPT model contains only 10 to 20 layers, and there is little literature to discuss the training of deep BERT/GPT. This paper proposes a simple yet effective method to stabilize BERT and GPT training. We successfully scale up BERT and GPT to 1,000 layers, which is an order of magnitude deeper than previous BERT and GPT.

arxiv-2209-12488.title: On the mean curvature type flow for convex capillary hypersurfaces in the ball
arxiv-2209-12488.creator: Yingxiang Hu, Yong Wei, Bo Yang, Tailong Zhou
arxiv-2209-12488.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yingxiang Hu, Yong Wei, Bo Yang, Tailong Zhou. In this paper, we study the mean curvature type flow for hypersurfaces in the unit Euclidean ball with capillary boundary, which was introduced by Wang-Xia [ Wang-Xia2019 ] and Wang-Weng [ WW2020 ] . We show that if the initial hypersurface is strictly convex, then the solution of this flow is strictly convex for t > 0 t>0 , exists for all positive time and converges smoothly to a spherical cap.

The 2021-22 High-Energy Physics Community Planning Exercise (a.k.a. “Snowmass 2021”) was organized by the Division of Particles and Fields of the American Physical Society. Snowmass 2021 was a scientific study that provided an opportunity for the entire U.S. particle physics community, along with its international partners, to identify the most important scientific questions in High Energy Physics for the following decade, with an eye to the decade after that, and the experiments, facilities, infrastructure, and R&D needed to pursue them.

arxiv-2502-15650.creator: Omri Gotlib, Tali Kaufman, Shachar Lovett
arxiv-2502-15650.description: Abstract Reed-Muller codes consist of evaluations of n n -variate polynomials over a finite field 𝔽 \mathbbm{F} with degree at most d d . pmc-10648468.title: Characterization of Environmental Levels of Pesticide Residues in Household Air and Dust Samples near a Bioenergy Plant Using Treated Seed as Feedstock
pmc-10648468.creator: Jabeen Taiba, Eleanor G. Rogan, Daniel D. Snow, Chandran Achutan, Muhammad Zahid
pmc-10648468.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Exposure to neonicotinoid insecticides is associated with adverse human health outcomes. There is environmental contamination in Saunders County, Nebraska, due to the accumulation of fungicides and insecticides from a now-closed ethanol plant using seed corn as stock. A pilot study quantified environmental contamination in nearby houses from residual pesticides by measuring dust and air (indoor/outdoor) concentrations of neonicotinoids and fungicides at the study site (households within two miles of the plant) and control towns (20–30 miles away).

pmc-10672483.description: Bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) is the most common congenital heart disease, with a prevalence of 1–2% and occurring in >20% of octogenarians referred for aortic valve replacement. Since TAVI indications are moving toward low-risk patients, an increase in the number of BAV patients who undergo TAVI is expected.

uslaw-usc-t7-s2257.title: 7 U.S.C. § 2257 — Interchangeability of funds for miscellaneous expenses and general expenses
uslaw-usc-t7-s2257.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s2257.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 55 (Department Of Agriculture). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Not to exceed 7 per centum of the amounts appropriated for any fiscal year for the miscellaneous expenses of the work of any bureau, division, or office of the Department of Agriculture shall be available interchangeably for expenditures on the objects included within the general expenses.
